plain: A man named Glenn Gaffney is said to have blocked a transfer of UFO material from the defense company Lockheed Martin to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. Michels relays this as what a couple of people have said, one of them under oath in testimony before Congress, and it matters because it would mean recovered UFO material exists and someone decides who gets it.
